name: Cornerless Ample Families Are Exactly Admissible Oriented One-Hole Covers
statement: Cornerless ampleness is equivalent to admitting an admissible oriented one-hole cover. Every cornerless ample family has a canonical recoverable cover $\mathcal W(H)=\{(x^B,B):x\in H,\ B\in\mathcal N(\Lambda_H(x)),\ |B|\ge2\}$.
proof: For an admissible cover, Sandwich equality gives ampleness. Each concept is an antipode $y^B$ of a protected punctured cube; all proper flips in $B$ occur while the missing tip $y$ does not, so the maximal cubes through that concept cannot be unique. Conversely, at every concept of a cornerless ample family the local cube-support complex is not a simplex. Each nontrivial minimal nonface $B$ yields a missing tip $x^B$ and a punctured cube whose antipode is $x$. Taking all such pairs covers the family, excludes all tips, and inherits Sandwich equality from ampleness.
